items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Had a big fella there by the name of Stack of Dollars. He told Chris to play him the three sixes. He told me...

ctx.x: Oh yeah, it makes it all day long. On Durden Street. I have a picture of it. I took a picture of it.

I think me and Chris played the last dance of that. The guy broke it up. I'll never forget that. Had a little pulleys. He wasn't heavy. But every time he started, he's up on the bandstand looking out on it. I'm telling you, that place was packed. As soon as you see a humbug, he was down there and grabbed them two guys coming on out of him. Take him right out. Yeah. Had a big fella there by the name of Stack of Dollars. He told Chris to play him the three sixes. He told me, see that little cop there, he's gonna…
Was it a stack of dollars? Yeah.
